notes.title: To celebrate the release of Dragon Spirits 2, we've added Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
Dragon Spirits 2 contains spoilers for the previous title! The stories don't rely on each other, except for some background info on the characters.
They are more like two works in the same universe. Despite keeping the core of the Dragon Spirits battle system, we have introduced many fresh ideas in other parts of the game. If you're curious about the new game, you can give the free prologue version a shot first.

When developing DS1, I completely outsourced the localization work, and I WON'T MAKE THAT MISTAKE AGAIN.
If the game mechanics of DS series are poorly translated, it'll be like playing Yu-Gi-Oh with Google Translation!
I did the translation on my own this time (300,000 characters! So much text! I double-checked the key parts), but English isn't my first language. Fingers crossed it's improved!

The main differences between Dragon Spirits 2 and 1:
1. Resolution improved, mouse supported, the UI focuses more on simplicity and ease of use. Controller is under consideration. The correspondence between mouse and controller is not as simple as that between keyboard and controller.
2. In order to achieve a 2.5D-like three-dimensional sense and enhance the visual effects of battle animations, the layout of the battle system was changed from side-view to front-view (by default, the layout can be adjusted to a certain extent).
3. The theme is urban fantasy, so the art style is adapted. Due to limited budget and game assets, the scene exploration is changed to VR-like first-person perspective horizontal scrolling (with encounter changed from random to symbol), and the plot performance is more similar to a visual novel.
4. Each Dragon Spirit has unique combos, with an increase in the number of exclusive skills. We try to avoid one Dragon Spirit being completely a higher substitute of another.
5. The maximum level is increased from 20 to 100. (The EXP curve has been adjusted accordingly, reaching the maximum level does not take 5 times the original) Leveling can suppress opponents with Stats to a certain extent, but the feature of Dragon Spirits series is to use build and tactics to outsmart opponents with high Stats. Level 100 still cannot form a significant suppress against level 90.
6. The EXP distribution system is changed to Cognition Mould system. A Dragon Spirit can be equipped with up to 3 Moulds to adjust its six Stats, preventing the need to distribute EXP repeatedly as Dragon Spirits' battle roles shift in various situations.

Future plans: I'll base the number of future updates on the situation post-release. First, I will adjust balance and add some new DS, gradually optimize the English translation and adjust game balance and difficulty based on player feedback.
It's just too much work to make a big dream game, and the risks and pressure are too high. I'd prefer to make some casual games like click games or simulation games (maybe Dragon Spirits Universe?) to chill out...
I made DS1 when I was in college. I had a ton of free time back then, so I took my time sketching out a complete series of world maps. Creating game maps takes a lot of time and effort. If I get fortunate and become really rich, I could possibly employ a few more people and start a game with a large number of maps to explore, and maybe even make it 3D.
Just kidding, it's not probable. Only big companies can manage the cost of such a game. Indie games still need to find ways to save money to get finished on time.

notes.title: Dragon Spirits Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Future Dragon Contractors,

We are thrilled to announce——after a long wait, Dragon Spirits is finally launched! We hope you have prepared yourself to start your adventure at Dragon Spirits, a world where reality and fantasy are intertwined. The game is priced at 9.99 USD / 9.75 EUR, with a release discount of 20% for one week you won’t want to miss out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36299641/a5681c76600b1715855ebaa099d504217bf3e742.png

Dragon Spirits is an academy life backgrounded dragon-collecting adventure RPG, rich in plots and collectible elements. The story text is over 300,000 words in its original language, and the playthrough (side quests cleared) takes over 50 hours. As a new student at the academy, you will learn about the theoretical knowledge of Dragon Spirits, [strike]skip class to[/strike] train your practice skills, freely explore diverse maps, and contract with more than 150 Dragon Spirits including the Four Holy Dragons … … We sincerely hope this journey will bring you unforgettable memories.

It has been two years and eight months since the first release of the demo. Initially, it was just a momentary impulse from my student days. It was the help and support of like-minded friends, the enthusiasm and companionship of players that made this dream come true. I hope this game, which carries personal significance, can go further and resonate with more players.

If you have any questions during playing, welcome to join our discord: https://discord.gg/5CxhkkE Communicate with developers and other players.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074190/

FAQ
Q: Cannot launch the game (crashes or errors), what should I do? 
A: Start the game in compatibility mode. If it still fails to start, uninstall and reinstall the game. It is likely that some files are missing. In extremely rare cases, the computer may be incompatible with the engine. (When the game can be started in compatibility mode but cannot be started in normal mode, possible causes: incorrect installation of DirectX 9, incompatible system, no audio device, etc.)

Q: The graphics are not clear enough, is there a solution? 
A: You can use external tools to enlarge the game window or overlay a sharpening filter. The original resolution of the game is 640x480, and the default setting is to enlarge the window twice. Different systems use different enlargement algorithms, resulting in different displays.

Q: A window popped up in the middle of the game, and then the game exited. What should I do? 
A: It is most likely a BUG, but there is also a very small possibility that the game's memory usage has reached its limit. Take a screenshot of the window and send it to the developer. We will analyze the problem based on the error message.

Q: I manually backed up my save data of Dragon Spirits: Prologue, can I use this save data in the official version of Dragon Spiritis?
A: Sure. Right-click on the game in your Steam library, select "Manage" -> "browse local files". Paste the backed-up "SaveXX.rvdata2" file in the "Save" folder here.

notes.title: Dragon Spirits - Steam Summer Festival Event
notes.content:
The Steam Summer Festival is coming and we would like to thank you all for taking part in our Beta tests. Your input helps us greatly to make this game better.

This game's default language is Chinese. We are still working hard on the English localization. So far, 90% of the content you can see and play in the demo build is already in English, but we want to remind you that you may still find some untranslated texts here and there in the following parts:
 

 1 main story scene
 2 side quests about historical memory.
 3 side quests about dragon spirits contract.
 several book items

 
It may cost a few weeks to get the English localization full ready. When we finish that, we’ll release the demo version again on Steam and itch.io.
If you have any question, feel free to join the Discord community and contact us: https://discord.gg/5CxhkkE

ABOUT THE GAME

Dragon Spirits is a JRPG with the tactical, challenging, and exciting real-time combat system and the core of its game mechanic is inspired by the Pokémon series.
While constantly working on a video game without any rest, a college student who's about to graduate quietly slipped into slumber several times. In those lucid dreams, he found himself in the game he was working on, the fantasy world of Dragon Spirits.
